# Scrybe

> Scrybe is an auto typer for Google Docs and an AI essay writer in one Chrome extension. It types text you provide into an open Google Doc word by word, at a speed you control, instead of pasting it in one block.

Scrybe is made for students and writers who work in Google Docs. Use the Type Text tab as a standalone auto typer, or use the AI essay writer to draft an essay from a prompt and then type the result into the document.

## Primary page

- [Auto typer for Google Docs](https://getscrybe.net/essay-typer): What an auto typer is, how Scrybe types text, supported text types, and pricing.
- [Markdown version of the auto typer page](https://getscrybe.net/essay-typer.md): Clean text for AI agents and retrieval systems.

## What Scrybe does

- Types any text you provide into an open Google Doc using simulated keystrokes.
- Controls typing speed in words per minute and supports pause, resume, and stop.
- Works with your own writing or text generated by an AI tool.
- Runs as a Chrome extension on ChromeOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Includes an AI essay writer that drafts from a prompt, rubric, word count, and academic level.
- Includes a humanizing pass and rubric upload on every plan.

## Plans

- Free: 2 essays per month up to 500 words each, plus 2 Type Text sessions per day up to 250 words each. Typing speed is capped at 60 WPM.
- Pro: $5/month or $40/year. 20 essays per month up to 5,000 words each, 20 Type Text sessions per day up to 2,000 words each, and no typing speed cap.
- Unlimited: $25/month or $200/year. 200 essays per month with no word cap, unlimited Type Text sessions, and unlimited words per session.

Prices are in USD. See [Scrybe pricing](https://getscrybe.net/#pricing) for current details.

## How the auto typer works

1. Install Scrybe from the Chrome Web Store.
2. Open a Google Doc and open the Scrybe extension.
3. Paste text into the Type Text tab.
4. Choose a words-per-minute speed or target duration.
5. Press start. Scrybe types the text into the document character by character.

## Common questions

### What is an auto typer?

An auto typer is a tool that enters text into a document character by character instead of pasting it all at once. Scrybe is a Chrome extension auto typer built for Google Docs.

### What exactly is an essay typer?

An essay typer is a tool that writes or types an essay into a document. Scrybe can generate a draft and type it into Google Docs, or type an essay you already have.

### Is Scrybe an auto typer or an essay writer?

Both. The Type Text tab is the auto typer. The Write Essay tab drafts an essay from a prompt and rubric, then types the result into Google Docs.

### Can I use text I wrote myself?

Yes. Scrybe is not limited to AI-generated text. Paste your own writing into the Type Text tab and Scrybe types it into the document.

### Does Scrybe paste the text?

No. Scrybe uses simulated keystrokes, so the text appears progressively instead of as one large paste.

### Does Scrybe work outside Google Docs?

Scrybe is built specifically for typing into Google Docs in Chrome.
